description: This file declares utility functions and types for handling MAC addresses, including conversion, comparison, and ARP-based lookup, used within a network-related software component.

methods.name: lookupMacAddressByIpAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address associated with a given IP address using ARP.

methods.name: macAddrToUUID
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string to a UUID format by removing colons and leading zeros.

methods.name: macAddrToBytes
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string to a byte array, handling colon-separated or plain formats.

methods.name: compareMacAddrs
methods.description: Compares two MAC address byte arrays, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: setMacAddressForIP
methods.description: Sets an ARP cache entry for a specified IP address with a given MAC address.
